This '''base''' was a training facility used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Hidden in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the [[22nd infantry division]] was trained at the facility.
